passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded: Instruct the Israelites to bring you an unblemished red heifer that has no defect and has never been placed under a yoke.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
He gave them a command.
He said, “This is the rule of the law that I have commanded.
Speak to the Israelites.
Tell them to bring you a red heifer.
The heifer must be perfect.
It must have no defect.
No yoke must have ever been placed on it.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר דַּבֵּ֣ר׀ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֣וּ אֵלֶיךָ֩ פָרָ֨ה אֲדֻמָּ֜ה תְּמִימָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵֽין־ בָּהּ֙ מ֔וּם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ עָלָ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ עֹֽל׃

passages.text: Give it to Eleazar the priest, and he will have it brought outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar is a priest of Israel.
You must give the red heifer to Eleazar the priest.
He will take the heifer outside the camp.
He will have the heifer slaughtered there.
The slaughter will happen in Eleazar’s presence.
passages.original: וּנְתַתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔הּ אֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהוֹצִ֤יא אֹתָהּ֙ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֹתָ֖הּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar is a priest.
He must take some of the heifer’s blood.
He uses his finger to take the blood.
He sprinkles the blood seven times.
He sprinkles it toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֞ח אֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מִדָּמָ֖הּ בְּאֶצְבָּע֑וֹ וְהִזָּ֞ה אֶל־ נֹ֨כַח פְּנֵ֧י אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֛ד מִדָּמָ֖הּ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃

passages.text: Then the heifer must be burned in his sight. Its hide, its flesh, and its blood are to be burned, along with its dung.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar is the priest.
He must watch the heifer.
They must burn the heifer while he watches.
They must burn its hide.
They must burn its flesh.
They must burn its blood.
They must burn its dung.
passages.original: וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֶת־ הַפָּרָ֖ה לְעֵינָ֑יו אֶת־ עֹרָ֤הּ וְאֶת־ בְּשָׂרָהּ֙ וְאֶת־ דָּמָ֔הּ עַל־ פִּרְשָׁ֖הּ יִשְׂרֹֽף׃

passages.text: The priest is to take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
passages.sermon:
The priest serves God and leads the people in worship.
The priest must take cedar wood.
The priest must take hyssop.
The priest must take scarlet wool.
The priest must throw the cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool onto the burning heifer.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֣ח הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עֵ֥ץ אֶ֛רֶז וְאֵז֖וֹב וּשְׁנִ֣י תוֹלָ֑עַת וְהִשְׁלִ֕יךְ אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ שְׂרֵפַ֥ת הַפָּרָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water; after that he may enter the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
The priest must wash his clothes.
The priest must bathe his body in water.
After this, the priest may enter the camp.
The priest will remain ceremonially unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכִבֶּ֨ס בְּגָדָ֜יו הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְרָחַ֤ץ בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ בַּמַּ֔יִם וְאַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְטָמֵ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: The one who burned the heifer must also wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he too will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
A person burned the heifer.
This person must wash his clothes in water.
He must bathe his body in water.
He will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְהַשֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֤ס בְּגָדָיו֙ בַּמַּ֔יִם וְרָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְטָמֵ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to gather up the ashes of the heifer and store them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They must be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.
passages.sermon:
A man who is ceremonially clean must gather the ashes of the heifer.
He must place the ashes outside the camp.
He must put them in a place that is ceremonially clean.
The congregation of Israel must keep these ashes.
They use the ashes to prepare water for purification.
This water is for purification from sin.
passages.original: וְאָסַ֣ף׀ אִ֣ישׁ טָה֗וֹר אֵ֚ת אֵ֣פֶר הַפָּרָ֔ה וְהִנִּ֛יחַ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה בְּמָק֣וֹם טָה֑וֹר וְ֠הָיְתָה לַעֲדַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְמִשְׁמֶ֛רֶת לְמֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה חַטָּ֥את הִֽוא׃

passages.text: The man who has gathered up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he will be ceremonially unclean until evening. This is a permanent statute for the Israelites and for the foreigner residing among them.
passages.sermon:
A man gathers the ashes of the heifer.
This man must wash his clothes in water.
He will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
This rule is a permanent law.
This law is for the Israelites.
This law is also for any foreigner living among them.
passages.original: וְ֠כִבֶּס הָאֹסֵ֨ף אֶת־ אֵ֤פֶר הַפָּרָה֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּ֛ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Whoever touches any dead body will be unclean for seven days.
passages.sermon: A person touches a dead human body.\r\nThat person becomes unclean.\r\nThis uncleanness lasts for seven days.
passages.original: הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּמֵ֖ת לְכָל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: He must purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third and seventh days, he will not be clean.
passages.sermon:
A person who touches a dead body becomes unclean.
He must purify himself with the special water.
He must do this on the third day.
He must do this again on the seventh day.
If he purifies himself on both days, he will become clean.
If he does not purify himself on the third and seventh days, he will not become clean.
passages.original: ה֣וּא יִתְחַטָּא־ ב֞וֹ בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י יִטְהָ֑ר וְאִם־ לֹ֨א יִתְחַטָּ֜א בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י לֹ֥א יִטְהָֽר׃

passages.text: Anyone who touches a human corpse and fails to purify himself defiles the tabernacle of the LORD. That person must be cut off from Israel. He remains unclean, because the water of purification has not been sprinkled on him, and his uncleanness is still on him.
passages.sermon:
Anyone who touches a dead human body becomes unclean.
If that person does not purify himself, he defiles the tabernacle of the LORD.
The person who does this must be separated from Israel.
He is still unclean.
The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him.
His uncleanness remains on him.
passages.original: כָּֽל־ הַנֹּגֵ֡עַ בְּמֵ֣ת בְּנֶפֶשׁ֩ הָאָדָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר־ יָמ֜וּת וְלֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֗א אֶת־ מִשְׁכַּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ טִמֵּ֔א וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּי֩ מֵ֨י נִדָּ֜ה לֹא־ זֹרַ֤ק עָלָיו֙ טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה ע֖וֹד טֻמְאָת֥וֹ בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: This is the law when a person dies in a tent: Everyone who enters the tent and everyone already in the tent will be unclean for seven days, and any open container without a lid fastened on it is unclean.
passages.sermon:
This law explains what happens when a person dies inside a tent.
If a person dies in a tent, everyone who enters that tent becomes unclean.
Everyone who is already inside the tent also becomes unclean.
They will be unclean for seven days.
Any open container in the tent is unclean.
If the container does not have a lid fastened on it, it is unclean.
passages.original: זֹ֚את הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אָדָ֖ם כִּֽי־ יָמ֣וּת בְּאֹ֑הֶל כָּל־ הַבָּ֤א אֶל־ הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאֹ֔הֶל יִטְמָ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃ וְכֹל֙ כְּלִ֣י פָת֔וּחַ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵין־ צָמִ֥יד פָּתִ֖יל עָלָ֑יו טָמֵ֖א הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Anyone in the open field who touches someone who has been killed by the sword or has died of natural causes, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.
passages.sermon:
Anyone in the open field who touches a dead body becomes unclean.
This includes anyone who touches a person killed by the sword.
This also includes anyone who touches a person who died naturally.
Anyone who touches a human bone becomes unclean.
Anyone who touches a grave becomes unclean.
That person will be unclean for seven days.
passages.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּ֜ע עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה בַּֽחֲלַל־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְמֵ֔ת אֽוֹ־ בְעֶ֥צֶם אָדָ֖ם א֣וֹ בְקָ֑בֶר יִטְמָ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: For the purification of the unclean person, take some of the ashes of the burnt sin offering, put them in a jar, and pour fresh water over them.
passages.sermon:
A person may become unclean.
God gave a law for purifying an unclean person.
Take some ashes from the burnt sin offering.
Put the ashes into a jar.
Pour fresh water over the ashes in the jar.
passages.original: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ לַטָּמֵ֔א מֵעֲפַ֖ר שְׂרֵפַ֣ת הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְנָתַ֥ן עָלָ֛יו מַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים אֶל־ כֶּֽלִי׃

passages.text: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings, and the people who were there. He is also to sprinkle the one who touched a bone, a grave, or a person who has died or been slain.
passages.sermon:
A man who is ceremonially clean must act.
He takes some hyssop.
He dips the hyssop in the water.
He sprinkles the tent with the water.
He sprinkles all the furnishings with the water.
He sprinkles all the people who were in the tent with the water.
He sprinkles anyone who touched a human bone.
He sprinkles anyone who touched a person killed by the sword.
He sprinkles anyone who touched a dead body.
He sprinkles anyone who touched a grave.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֨ח אֵז֜וֹב וְטָבַ֣ל בַּמַּיִם֮ אִ֣ישׁ טָהוֹר֒ וְהִזָּ֤ה עַל־ הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ וְעַל־ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְעַל־ הַנְּפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽיוּ־ שָׁ֑ם וְעַל־ הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בַּעֶ֙צֶם֙ א֣וֹ בֶֽחָלָ֔ל א֥וֹ בַמֵּ֖ת א֥וֹ בַקָּֽבֶר׃

passages.text: The man who is ceremonially clean is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day. After he purifies the unclean person on the seventh day, the one being cleansed must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and that evening he will be clean.
passages.sermon:
A man who is ceremonially clean must act.
He must sprinkle the unclean person.
He must do this on the third day.
He must do this again on the seventh day.
On the seventh day, he purifies the unclean person.
The person who is being cleansed must wash his clothes.
He must also bathe in water.
He will become clean in the evening.
passages.original: וְהִזָּ֤ה הַטָּהֹר֙ עַל־ הַטָּמֵ֔א בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖י וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְחִטְּאוֹ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵ֥ר בָּעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: But if a person who is unclean does not purify himself, he will be cut off from the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.
passages.sermon:
A person may become unclean.
If an unclean person does not purify himself, he will be separated from the community.
This person has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD.
The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him.
He remains unclean.
passages.original: וְאִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִטְמָא֙ וְלֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֔א וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַקָּהָ֑ל כִּי֩ אֶת־ מִקְדַּ֨שׁ יְהוָ֜ה טִמֵּ֗א מֵ֥י נִדָּ֛ה לֹא־ זֹרַ֥ק עָלָ֖יו טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃

passages.text: This is a permanent statute for the people: The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes, and whoever touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a permanent law.
This law applies to all generations.
A person may sprinkle the water of purification on others.
This person must wash his clothes after sprinkling the water.
Anyone who touches the water of purification becomes unclean.
This person remains unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָּהֶ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּמַזֵּ֤ה מֵֽי־ הַנִּדָּה֙ יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְהַנֹּגֵ֙עַ֙ בְּמֵ֣י הַנִּדָּ֔ה יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Anything the unclean person touches will become unclean, and anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening.”
passages.sermon:
An unclean person can touch things.
Anything the unclean person touches becomes unclean.
A person who touches what the unclean person touched also becomes unclean.
That person will remain unclean until evening.
passages.original: וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּע־ בּ֥וֹ הַטָּמֵ֖א יִטְמָ֑א וְהַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַנֹּגַ֖עַת תִּטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃פ
